visualIssues.detail: Hardcoded saturated purple confidence fill and forecast stroke (line 107), plus fixed cyan rate stroke/dots (line 149), bypass selected chart palette.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing palette/semantic chart tokens; preserve confidence band, dashed forecast distinction, legends, all series and saved palette choices.

visualIssues.detail: Insight tile explicitly uses white border/background overlays. Pie fills at lines 70-71 are fixed saturated colors.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing theme surface/border tokens and restrained semantic palette while retaining every insight, category and accessible table.

visualIssues.detail: Shell forwards explicit cyan/green glow requested by billing, calculator, lifetime and environment callers. Actual effective glow intensity was not measured.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer neutral shared surface/default glow unless semantic emphasis is justified; do not reset user theme preferences.

architectureIssues.detail: Page consumes calendar start/end and forwards those at lines 72-73, not startInstant/endInstantExclusive. Shared hook exposes precise rolling 24h/live instants and timezone-aware exclusive calendar bounds at useRangeState.ts:656-682.
architectureIssues.fix: Thread typed instant bounds through the existing hook and server filtering after integration review; preserve both aliases, URL/preferences and rolling/timezone semantics. Do not add a second picker.

architectureIssues.detail: Nullable cost_decimal is reduced with ?? 0 in headline/month/category/hour metrics (lines 43,78,119,144), so unpriced sessions contribute free-looking totals and blended rates. Missing distance is likewise zeroed at line 49. Rate series correctly filters unpriced sessions, while aggregates do not disclose coverage.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep priced/unpriced and known/unknown distance coverage distinct, preserving real zero-cost sessions. Represent unavailable rates/savings explicitly and retain existing calculation definitions unless separately authorized.

architectureIssues.detail: All cost_decimal values are summed without cost_currency grouping. ChargingSession exposes nullable cost_currency at api/types.ts:179; useFormatting.ts:45-56 prefixes a saved display symbol without FX. Raw source currency is lost from monthly/category/core view models.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain source denomination, show unsupported/mixed/unknown currency explicitly and avoid silently relabeling or summing unlike currencies. Do not invent FX/backend capabilities; preserve saved formatting preferences separately from source ownership.

architectureIssues.detail: Summary labels the unchanged gasPrice per L when gas_unit=liter, but calculator suffix remains $/gal and derivation uses US gallons. Thus identical assumption can be presented with inconsistent volume identity.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep the gallon-based model explicit or use existing verified conversion at input/display boundary; preserve assumption values/defaults and avoid changing calculation semantics casually.

architectureIssues.detail: Fixed $/gal and $/kWh suffixes (line 69) conflict with preference-backed currency formatting elsewhere; this is distinct from source-currency aggregation.
architectureIssues.fix: Derive localized currency/rate labels from known source/assumption denomination using existing formatting; preserve gallon/MPG assumption basis until a verified conversion contract exists.

architectureIssues.detail: Independent billing uses raw isLoading/error; retained payload remains visible via CostStatSection, but billing is absent from PageLayout.dataSources and lacks a shared offline/stale DataState warning. Forecast/session trust handling is stronger.
architectureIssues.fix: Adopt existing useDataState/StaleRefreshWarning for this query and expose source trust without merging its independent period into selected-session scope.

architectureIssues.detail: Forecast wire contract declares kwh (also line 83) and avg_km_per_month (line 98). ForecastDetails.tsx:140 bridges km into canonical metrics. These are source-confirmed noncanonical unit names; actual server payload semantics were not inspected.
architectureIssues.fix: Escalate endpoint/DTO SI contract verification to integration owner before canonical conversion; do not guess units, add dual-shape adapters or multiply unverified fields.
architectureIssues.confidence: high for declared fields; backend semantics unknown

architectureIssues.detail: Legend calls interval '95% Confidence'; the AI narration's source description explicitly calls the same band APPROXIMATE and not a strict 95% confidence interval. Model calibration not independently verified.
architectureIssues.fix: Use source-verified interval terminology consistently while retaining cost_low/cost_high and all chart data; obtain integration confirmation rather than inventing calibration.

architectureIssues.detail: Monthly buckets use browser getFullYear/getMonth and hourly/off-peak grouping uses getHours (lines 141,166), without explicit workspace/vehicle timezone. This can differ from the intended selected time scope.
architectureIssues.fix: Align derived bucket timezone with existing scoped date mechanisms after identifying authoritative timezone; preserve bucket/session counts and clearly label TOU assumptions, which are currently fixed 14-19 and 22-06 rather than verified utility rates.
